blocks.text:
party_list = ["Buy drinks", "Buy decorations", "Buy snacks", "Buy cold drinks"]
party_list.insert(0, "Invite friends")      # add at the start
party_list.append("Order cake")            # add at the end
party_list.extend(["Party hats", "Streamers"])    # add several at once
print(party_list)

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
party_list = ["Invite friends", "Buy decorations", "Buy snacks", "Buy cold drinks"]
party_list.remove("Buy snacks")    # removes the first match
party_list.pop(0)                  # removes the item at index 0
print(party_list)                  # ['Buy decorations', 'Buy cold drinks']
party_list.clear()                 # removes all items
print(party_list)                  # []

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa function list ke aakhir mein cheez jorta hai (MCQ 1)? List ke saath 'in' kya karta hai (MCQ 2)?
blocks.explanation: (b) append(); (c) yeh jaanchta hai ke cheez list mein maujood hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: extend() kaise kaam karta hai, misal ke saath bataiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: extend() doosri list (ya sequence) ki har cheez list ke aakhir mein ek ek kar ke jorta hai: a = [1, 2]; a.extend([3, 4]) se a = [1, 2, 3, 4]. Is ke bar-aks append([3, 4]) poori list ko ek cheez bana kar jorta: [1, 2, [3, 4]].

blocks.prompt: Jab do variables ek hi list ki taraf ishara karein to kya masail ho sakte hain, misal ke saath (short question 2)?
blocks.explanation: b = a list ki copy nahi banata; dono naam ek hi list ki taraf ishara karte hain, to ek naam se tabdeeli doosre se bhi nazar aati hai: a = [1, 2]; b = a; b.append(3) se a bhi [1, 2, 3] ho jata hai, jo ghair mutawaqqo bugs paida kar sakta hai. Alag copy ke liye b = a.copy() ya b = list(a) istemal karein. Yeh aam Python ilm hai; chapter mein nahi.

blocks.prompt: Long question 2: tasks = [design, development, testing, deployment] se shuru karein; aakhir mein 'review' jorein, teesri jagah 'planning' dakhil karein, 'testing' ko 'quality assurance' badlein, 'development' hatayein, index 1 wala kaam hatayein, 'deployment' ka index dhoondein, aur aakhri list aur us ki lambai print karein.
blocks.explanation: tasks.append("review"); tasks.insert(2, "planning"); tasks[tasks.index("testing")] = "quality assurance"; tasks.remove("development"); tasks.pop(1) 'planning' hatata hai; tasks.index("deployment") 2 hai; aakhri list design, quality assurance, deployment, review, aur len(tasks) 4.

items: Dakhil: insert(), append(), extend(); hatana: remove(), pop(), clear(); talash: in, index().
